assumptions: the creature attacks every turn it is untapped and not summoning-sick
blocker perturbation: each attack's trigger is lost with probability `block` (deterministic expectation)
removal perturbation: the creature survives each opponent turn cycle with probability `survive`, compounded from the turn it lands (deterministic expectation)
modules.determinism: seeded paired v1.1 games (grixis_sim.seed_for); perturbations are closed-form expectations (no rng)
does_not_model: trigger payloads (damage, tokens, cards): counted as triggers only
actual opponents, blockers, combat math or politics
attack restrictions, tapping for other costs, vigilance trade-offs
limitations: Proxy only: ranks how often a trigger can happen, not what it is worth.
Opponent behaviour is a fixed perturbation grid, reported as a sensitivity range.
models: turn a creature with a 'whenever ~ attacks' / 'whenever you attack' trigger is on your battlefield (zone trace)
summoning sickness (haste attacks the turn it lands)
expected attack-trigger count by turns 6/8/10 under a bounded blocker/removal perturbation grid

assumptions: a target is legal if its card model has the type the recursion text names (creature/artifact/instant/sorcery/permanent/any card)
no opponent interaction with the graveyard
modules.determinism: seeded paired v1.1 games (grixis_sim.seed_for); no extra rng
does_not_model: self-mill, discard outlets, opponents' removal filling the graveyard (the v1.1 graveyard is thin, so this under-counts)
the value of the returned card
graveyard hate from opponents (see stress scenario graveyard_exiled)
limitations: v1.1 sends few cards to the graveyard (no creature deaths), so live rates are lower bounds.
models: graveyard contents by turn from the v1.1 zone trace (cards the model already puts there: spent spells, sacrificed/used one-shots, scenario events)
turn a recursion card is available (on battlefield or in hand) while your graveyard holds a legal target of the type it names
P(recursion live by turn 4/6/8) and mean legal targets when live
